description_excerpt: Job Description Come join our team and be part of developing the latest 5G Radio technologies that will be used by billions of people around the world! We are looking for a Infrastructure Engineer to design, integrate, and maintain the Test Channels (TCs) integrated with vDU (Virtualized Distributed Unit). The role focuses on ensuring a stable, scalable, and efficient test environment, handling Trouble Reports (TRs), performing lab operations, and rebuilding existing test platforms to secure operational continuity.
